Definition: Whether the instant payment system supports business payments to suppliers, vendors, contractors, and other businesses for commercial transactions, procurement, and supply chain payments.
Comments: B2B payments are enabled at least through existing interbank transfer and clearing infrastructure (BCEAO-operated STAR-UEMOA RTGS for urgent/large transactions) used by banks and corporates in WAEMU, including Mali-based participants.

Definition: Whether the instant payment system enables or plans to enable instant payments across national borders to other countries or regional payment systems, supporting remittances, trade, and regional integration.
Comments: Cross-border payment functionality exists within WAEMU rails (STAR-UEMOA enables interbank transactions in real time across WAEMU), and mobile money wallets in Mali receive international remittances via partnerships (e.g., TerraPay enabling remittances into Wave mobile wallets in Mali from US/Canada/Europe).

Definition: Whether the system enables consumer payments to merchants and businesses for goods and services, including retail purchases, bill payments, e-commerce, and subscription services.
Comments: P2B merchant payments are supported via mobile money in Mali (e.g., Orange Money advertises bill payments; Moov Money lists “SANI” merchant payment service for shopping in stores).

Definition: Whether the system enables citizen payments to government for taxes, fees, licenses, fines, utility bills, and other government service charges.
Comments: Person-to-government payments are supported at least for taxes/fees through government platforms: Mali’s DGI states payment of taxes via bank transfer is possible (2018) and Mali launched an online tax payment platform “E-Impôt”/telepayment (2021) for certain taxpayers.

Definition: Whether the instant payment system supports direct person-to-person transfer of funds between individuals for informal transactions, remittances, and interpersonal value transfers.
Comments: P2P transfers are widely available via mobile money services in Mali (e.g., Orange Money enables transfers to relatives; Moov Money app supports national/international transfers).

Definition: Whether the scheme rules governing payment system participation, pricing structure, technical requirements, security standards, and conduct are publicly accessible via website, public repository, or on request. Transparency indicator.
Comments: Public-facing BCEAO pages describe SICA-UEMOA/STAR-UEMOA and reference that formats/exchange rules/technical standards are described in “technical manuals”, but a publicly downloadable scheme rulebook for these payment systems (or WAEMU IPS rulebook) was not found in accessible official sources during this research.
